next.reason: 1985: "An index-name and a data item (other than an index data item) or literal."; 2023: "an index-name and a numeric data item or numeric literal.". Both compare the index-name's occurrence number to the other operand. As worded, 2023 limits that operand to numeric data items and numeric literals, where 1985 allowed any non-index data item or literal.
